name: Bloodwake
description: Awakens a bloodlust for %duration% turns, gaining %bonus_damage% bonus damage each turn it remains active. While it lasts, this unit's move actions are free and it may move twice per turn.
details: Landing a kill during the effect refreshes its duration, and recasting Bloodwake while it's already active does the same.
The bonus damage keeps accumulating regardless - refreshing the duration doesn't reset it.

upgrade.summary: Attacks also become free and can be made twice a turn, and refreshing the duration now extends it instead of resetting it.
upgrade.description: While active, this unit's move and attack actions are both free, and it may take each of them twice per turn.
details: Landing a kill or recasting Bloodwake while it's active still refreshes it, but now adds %duration% turns onto what's left instead of resetting the clock.
The bonus damage still accumulates and carries over exactly as before.
